sources.title: Longji Rice Terraces: Tips, Hiking Routes & Best Times
sources.content:
Longji Rice Terraces: Complete Guide

Overview
The Longji Rice Terraces, known as "Dragon Backbone" terraces, are located in Longsheng County near Guilin. These agricultural landscapes feature three main areas: Ping'an Village, Dazhai Village, and Ancient Zhuang Village. "Hiking through the rice terraces is the main way to marvel at the fantastic scenery."

Three Main Areas

Jinkeng Rice Terraces (Dazhai Village)
- Largest and most majestic terraced area
- 2.5 hours from Guilin
- Features cable car access
- Best for photography with views like "West Hill Music" viewing platform
- Rugged hiking trails requiring 2+ days
- Home to Hongyao people

Ping'an Rice Terraces
- 2 hours from Guilin
- Most developed and accessible for day trips
- Well-paved stone paths suitable for families and seniors
- Key viewpoints: "Seven Stars Accompany the Moon" and "Nine Dragons and Five Tigers"
- Inhabited by Zhuang people

Ancient Zhuang Rice Terraces
- 1.5 hours from Guilin
- Smallest and least crowded
- Authentic Zhuang village with stilt houses
- Limited accommodations (hostels/homestays only)
- Features Ethnic Minority Museum

Hiking Routes

Ping'an to Ancient Zhuang
- Duration: 2 hours, ~5 km
- Difficulty: Easy
- Ideal for day trips

Dazhai to Ping'an
- Duration: 5 hours, ~17 km
- Difficulty: Moderate
- Covers both major areas

Best Visit Times
Late May: Water-filled fields reflect sunlight like mirrors
Mid-June to Mid-September: Green rice plants fill paddies
Late September to Mid-October: Golden harvest fields. "You will see layers of golden yellow."
Winter: Brown empty fields (possibly snow December-February)

Seasonal Festivals
- Plowing Festival (mid-May)
- Rice Planting Festival (early June)
- Clothes Drying Festival (late June)

Accommodations
Ping'an Village: Baike Hotel (US$56+), Li An Lodge (US$206+)
Dazhai Village: Longji Panorama House Hotel (US$36+)

Transportation
From Guilin: Private transfer or taxi recommended (2-hour drive)
From Yangshuo: 4+ hour journey; private transfer suggested over coaches

sources.title: Longji Rice Terraces: the Complete Guide - Fabio Nodari
sources.content:
Longji Rice Terraces: the Complete Guide

Visit between late April and mid-October for the best views. More specifically, late May and late September are ideal periods to take photos and go hiking, since they offer iconic views with pleasant weather. Mid-May to early-June: The fields are water-filled before rice is planted, and you can see mirror-like rice fields and glitter in the sun in spring. By late September to October, the terraces turn into a golden landscape as the rice reaches maturity, with layered fields rippling in the autumn wind.

The Longji Rice Terraces are located in Longsheng County, about a two-hour drive from Guilin City. The bus is the most economical way to reach the terraces, but it is also the slowest, with the journey taking four to six hours.

The rice terraces encompass three main areas: Ping'an Village, Dazhai Village, and Ancient Zhuang Village. For a day trip, choose the Ping'an Rice Terraces, which offer the perfect balance: a relaxed pace and manageable hiking trails. The Jinkeng Rice Terraces are the largest and most majestic, and are the only area that can be visited by cable car.

Stay overnight in Ping'an or Dazhai to see the sunrise and sunset. After nightfall, the tranquility of the terraces is stunning, and sunrise the next morning is certainly worth waking up early for.

Parking lots are all outside the villages. You need to walk a length of narrow track with steps into the village and to your hotel, so you should avoid taking large luggage when visiting Longji Rice Terraces.

A mug of fragrant Longji tea or a glass of local sweet home-made rice wine will make delightful compliments to your meal. Bamboo rice is a must-try dish for travelers in Longsheng.

sources.title: Longji Rice Terraces: Best Time, Tickets & Transportation from Guilin
sources.content:
Longji Rice Terraces: Best Time, Tickets & Transportation from Guilin

The ticket price is about 80 RMB per person. Tickets are valid for 3 days from your selected visit date. Children under 1.2 meters (3.9 feet) or under 6 years old are free of charge.

Tickets are valid for visiting Ping'an Zhuang Village, Jinkeng Rice Terraces Fields (Dazhai Rice Terraces) and Huangluo Yao Village.

The opening hours of those ticket gates is usually from 9:00am to 18:00pm.

From Guilin Qintan Bus Station, direct buses depart for Longji Terraces daily from 7:00 AM to 5:20 PM, with services every 20 minutes. The bus ride to the Longji Terraces Intersection takes approximately 1.5 hours, and the total fare is 60 yuan, which includes the transfer service.

The only way to transfer in the scenic spots is walk. The cable car from the Dazhai Parking Lot to the Jinfo Ding (Golden Buddha Peak) costs CN 60 yuan one-way and CN 110 yuan return.

Visiting in autumn, especially from late September to early October is recommended, when the rice is ripe and the terraces turn into a golden sea.

sources.title: The best way to visit the Longji Rice Terraces from Guilin, China
sources.content:
The best way to visit the Longji Rice Terraces from Guilin

The Longji Rice Terraces (Dragon's Backbone) are located in the Guangxi region and were first built in the Yuan Dynasty—700 years ago—and are still used today. They are located in the Northeastern part of the province, about a three-hour ride from Guilin.

The terraces change dramatically with the seasons:
- The terraces are filled with water, creating huge mirrors, from the end of April to mid June.
- The fields are green, from July to mid September.
- The fields are yellow-green, and the rice has fully grown and is ready to be harvested, from late September to late October.

Hiking is by far the best way to explore the area, with the option to hike to the top in three to four hours, or enjoy a 50 minute walk to a panoramic view of the terraces. The roads in the scenic spot are all paved stone paths, so the only way to travel is to hike.

Ping'an, with a population of just 1,000, is home to the Zhuang people, while the Yao people live in Jinkeng. You can savor delicious local food, like bamboo shoots, organic eggplants, seasoned beef, and rice wine, with the local specialty bamboo rice.

An overnight stay at one of the many guesthouses provides the opportunity for a richer experience.

sources.title: Longji Rice Terraces in Guilin: Facts, What to Do & Best Time to Visit
sources.content:
Longji Rice Terraces in Guilin: Facts, What to Do & Best Time to Visit

Due to the rugged hiking trails and steep stairs, we suggest leaving at least 2 days for hiking all of Jinkeng's highlights. For a day trip, choose the Ping'an Rice Terraces, which offer the perfect balance: a relaxed pace and manageable hiking trails.

The best time to visit is from late April to mid-October. Late May and late September are ideal for photography.

The cable car in the Jinkeng area is the only mechanized transport within the scenic area, costing 60 yuan one-way or 110 yuan return.

Admission is 80 RMB per person, valid for 3 days.

sources.title: 龙脊梯田_百度百科
sources.content:
龙脊梯田百度百科

基本信息
龙脊梯田位于广西桂林市龙胜各族自治县龙脊镇平安村，是"广西壮族自治区龙胜县境内全球重要农业文化遗产"。占地面积66平方千米，门票价格80元，全年全天开放。

历史背景
该地区梯田耕作方式可追溯至秦汉时期。"至唐宋，龙胜龙脊梯田得到大规模开发，明清时期基本达到现有规模，至少有2300多年的历史"。1992年开始进行旅游开发。

地理特征
龙脊梯田属南岭山地越城岭，"最高处的梯田海拔1180米，最低处仅380米，垂直落差达800米"。属亚热带季风气候，年平均气温17度C，年均降水量1650毫米。植物资源丰富，共450种。

因为山脉像龙的背脊一样，故名"龙脊"，当地有句俗话："山是龙的脊，田是云中梯"。

景区布局
分为三个观景区：金坑-大寨红瑶梯田、平安壮族梯田、龙脊古壮寨梯田。著名景观包括"七星伴月""九龙五虎"等。

文化价值
"龙脊梯田是中国南方梯田农耕文化的代表"，内含6个国家传统村落、4个民族特色村寨、35项非遗项目。

所获荣誉
2010年晋升4A级景区；2017年获全球重要农业文化遗产；2020年入选国家湿地公园；2024年通过《龙胜龙脊梯田保护条例》。

sources.title: 龙脊梯田旅游最详细攻略 - 阳朔旅游
sources.content:
龙脊梯田旅游最详细攻略

门票信息：景区门票价格80元/人起。景区包括金坑红瑶梯田、平安壮族梯田、龙脊古壮寨、龙脊小寨红瑶四个景点，只要买了票，四个景点都能去。

1.2-1.4米儿童和60-64岁的门票为40元；65岁及以上门票为10元；1.2米以下儿童免费。

关于2026年特殊政策，龙脊梯田景区于2025年3月17日至2026年2月28日执行"一票三日制"，订单取票后3天内可使用。

最佳游览时间：4-5月梯田开始放水、5-6月刚插秧，以及9-10月稻谷成熟是观赏的黄金时期。

交通信息：梯田共有平安村、龙脊村、大寨三个入口，从桂林市区都有车到达每个入口。

主要景点：七星伴月、九龙五虎、千层天梯、西山韶乐和金佛顶等。

住宿建议：建议在平安或大寨住一晚，可以欣赏日出日落。

sources.title: 龙脊梯田门票预定 - 桂林国旅
sources.content:
龙脊梯田门票预定

龙脊梯田门票80元/人。景区开放时间全天。缆车单程60元，往返110元。

龙脊梯田分为平安壮族梯田和金坑红瑶梯田两大景区。平安梯田适合一日游，步行道路平整，适合老人和小孩。金坑梯田规模更大更壮观，但需要更多体力。

从桂林琴潭汽车站有直达班车，每20分钟一班，车程约1.5小时，票价60元含景区接驳。

龙脊梯田最佳旅游季节：
- 4-5月：灌水期，梯田如镜
- 6-9月：绿色梯田
- 9-10月：金色梯田（最美时节）
- 冬季：偶有雪景

必吃美食：竹筒饭是龙脊梯田的特色美食，用新鲜竹筒蒸煮，米饭带有竹子的清香。
